title: counter overshoots modulus
report: A mod-10 ModCounter shows 10 before going back to 0, and its wrap pulse comes one cycle late. A mod-4 counter never raises wrap at all.

title: gray decode wrong above 3
report: GrayToBin gives the wrong number for most codes above 3: converting a value to Gray code and back does not return the original value.

title: ALU subtracts the wrong way round
report: The ALU's SUB operation returns 249 for 10 - 3 and raises the borrow flag.

title: ALU carry flag wrong
report: The ALU raises carry on 100 + 50 even though the sum fits in 8 bits, and misses the carry on 200 + 100.

title: FIFO full one entry early
report: A 4-entry SyncFIFO reports full after only 3 writes and drops the 4th write.

title: UART bytes arrive bit-reversed
report: Bytes sent through UartTx arrive bit-reversed at the receiver: sending 0x01 is received as 0x80, and 0xA5 stays 0xA5.

title: PWM glitch at duty 0
report: With duty set to 0 the PWM output still goes high for one cycle every period, and duty 3 gives 4 high cycles.

title: debouncer lets bounces through
report: A bouncing button eventually registers as pressed with Debouncer(4), even though the input never stays high for 4 cycles in a row.

title: CRC-8 check value wrong
report: Crc8Byte does not produce the standard CRC-8 check value: chaining the bytes of b"123456789" from 0 should give 0xF4.
